description:
The Perarignar Anna Memorial Award is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Tamil Nadu. 

This award was established in the year 2009. 

It was created to honor the legacy of M. Karunanidhi, who was a prominent political leader and served as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu multiple times. 

The scheme is named after the late Chief Minister M. Bhaktavatsalam, who was also known as Perarignar Anna. 

The primary objective of the Perarignar Anna Memorial Award is to recognize and reward the contributions of individuals in the field of social service. 

The award aims to promote social justice and uplift marginalized communities. 

It specifically targets those who have made significant contributions to the welfare of the underprivileged. 

The award is given annually on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Perarignar Anna. 

This date falls on September 15 each year. 

The award consists of a cash prize and a certificate of recognition. 

As of the latest updates, the cash prize for the award is ₹1 lakh. 

The award is presented to individuals or organizations that have demonstrated exemplary service in various fields. 

These fields include education, health, women's empowerment, and rural development. 

The eligibility criteria for the Perarignar Anna Memorial Award are specific and well-defined. 

Individuals from all walks of life can apply for the award. 

However, they must have a proven track record of social service. 

There are no specific age limits for applicants. 

The award is open to both individuals and non-governmental organizations (NGOs). 

To apply for the award, candidates must submit a detailed application form. 

This form requires information about the applicant's background and contributions to society. 

Applicants must also provide documentary evidence of their social work. 

The application process typically begins in June each year. 

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set for July 31. 

Once applications are received, they are reviewed by a selection committee. 

This committee is composed of experts in social work and representatives from the government. 

The final decision on the award recipients is made by the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. 

The award ceremony is usually held in September. 

During the ceremony, the Chief Minister presents the award to the recipients. 

The Perarignar Anna Memorial Award has gained significant recognition over the years. 

Many notable individuals and organizations have received this prestigious award. 

The award serves as a motivation for others to engage in social service. 

It highlights the importance of community service and social responsibility. 

The Tamil Nadu government promotes the award through various channels. 

This includes public announcements and media coverage. 

The award is part of a broader initiative by the Tamil Nadu government to enhance social welfare. 

It aligns with the state's commitment to improving the quality of life for its citizens. 

The government encourages applications from diverse sectors. 

This includes education, healthcare, and environmental conservation. 

The award also aims to inspire youth participation in social initiatives. 

In recent years, the award has seen an increase in the number of applications. 

This reflects a growing awareness of social issues among the population. 

The Tamil Nadu government has allocated specific funds for the award. 

This ensures that the cash prize is available each year without any financial constraints. 

The award's impact can be seen in the increased number of social initiatives launched in the state. 

Many awardees have gone on to expand their projects and reach more beneficiaries. 

The Perarignar Anna Memorial Award is a testament to the state's dedication to social welfare. 

It serves as a platform for recognizing unsung heroes in the community. 

The award not only provides financial support but also enhances the visibility of social issues. 

It encourages collaboration between the government and civil society. 

The award has also inspired similar initiatives in other states. 

This reflects the replicable model of recognizing social contributions. 

The Tamil Nadu government continues to evaluate and improve the award process. 

Feedback from previous awardees is taken into consideration for future iterations. 

The award is a significant part of Tamil Nadu's welfare schemes. 

It underscores the importance of community service in achieving social equity. 

The Perarignar Anna Memorial Award is a shining example of how government initiatives can empower individuals. 

It fosters a culture of giving back to society. 

The award has become synonymous with excellence in social service in Tamil Nadu. 

Overall, the Perarignar Anna Memorial Award is a crucial initiative. 

It aims to uplift society by recognizing and rewarding those who contribute selflessly. 

The scheme continues to evolve and adapt to the changing needs of the community. 

It remains a vital part of Tamil Nadu's commitment to social justice and welfare. 

The award represents hope and inspiration for many aspiring social workers. 

Through this initiative, the Tamil Nadu government reinforces its pledge to support the marginalized. 

The Perarignar Anna Memorial Award is more than just a recognition. 

It is a call to action for everyone to engage in social service. 

The award embodies the spirit of community and collective responsibility. 

It is a reminder that every small effort counts in the journey towards social change. 

The legacy of Perarignar Anna lives on through the contributions of these awardees. 

The award continues to shine a light on the importance of social work in society. 

It is a beacon of hope for those striving to make a difference. 

The Perarignar Anna Memorial Award stands as a powerful symbol of social commitment. 

It encourages individuals to pursue their passion for helping others. 

The Tamil Nadu government remains steadfast in its support for this initiative. 

The award is a vital component of the state's welfare framework. 

It highlights the transformative power of social service in building a better society.
